findings.reason: The intent faithfully captures the requested latency-reduction investigation, preservation of retrieval quality, and evidence-grounded research report without inventing methods, thresholds, or results.

All material source requirements are represented: investigation purpose, report deliverable, latency and quality targets, local work, prohibition of cloud training and new datasets, reference compliance, and absence of supplied empirical measurements.

The baseline, metrics, scope, exclusions, and mandatory constraints agree with the sources and with each other. No provision authorizes remote work, cloud training, new datasets, or reduced retrieval quality.

The intent supplies an actionable investigation goal and explicit report result under clear execution and data constraints. Qualitative targets and absent measurements do not prevent compilation of this research request.

limitations: No empirical measurements are supplied; acceptance does not establish achieved latency reduction or preserved retrieval quality.
Methods and numeric performance thresholds are unspecified, consistent with the requested investigation.
